name: pure-helper-catalog
goal: Show only declared pure shared helpers and separate models from services

evidence: The catalog conflates shared exports with pure helpers and omits models. Require explicit checked pure contracts plus two actual consumers; keep service classes and data models in their own categories and preserve entity links.

Existing metadata and catalog suites covered sharing but not effects or purity; model policy deliberately hid models. Extend their matrices and the existing catalog browser flow to prove purity, Models navigation, and same-scope helper links.
Test-only 3c650c4e fails pure-contract metadata and model classification. The frozen browser catalog flow separately fails its Helpers heading after capturing the rendered before state.

Helpers require explicit @pure source declarations, a conservative no-effects/no-hidden-state guard and two consumers. Eleven reviewed formatters qualify. Models have routing, navigation, search, relationships and contract/source views; existing Services and function URLs remain available.
The unchanged 20 metadata cases and 18 catalog/category/label cases pass on the separate fix commit in the same shell environment.
